# company

Canonical field registry for company records (SPEC.md §4a, ADR-017). Company fields keep the company_ prefix so the same fact has the same name whether it appears on a company record or embedded on a person record. A subject type (ADR-054); the identity list is SPEC.md §4's company derivation.

## Identity

A company is keyed by the first of these tiers the record has, strongest first.

| Tier | From | Key |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | `company_domain` | the normalized value |
| 2 | `company_name` | a SHA-256 of those, prefixed `nh:` |

As the type file states it:

```json
[
  {
    "field": "company_domain"
  },
  {
    "hash": [
      "company_name"
    ],
    "prefix": "nh:"
  }
]
```

## Fields

| Field | Tier | Type | Normalization | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `company_domain` | identity | string | `domain` | Registrable domain (eTLD+1). Identity tier 1 for companies (SPEC.md §4). |
| `company_name` | identity | string | `trim` | Company name. Feeds the name-hash fallback tier (SPEC.md §4). |
| `company_website` | core | string (uri) | `trim` | Website URL as provided. company_domain is the comparable form. |
| `company_linkedin_url` | core | string (uri) | `linkedin_url` | LinkedIn company page URL. |
| `company_employees` | core | integer | `none` | Headcount as an integer — never a range string. |
| `company_industry` | core | string | `trim` | Industry label. Value domain deferred until a second adapter forces comparability (rule of two). |

## Examples

| Field | Example value |
|---|---|
| `company_domain` | acme.com |
| `company_name` | Acme Corp |
| `company_website` | https://www.acme.com |
| `company_linkedin_url` | https://www.linkedin.com/company/acme-corp |
| `company_employees` | 120 |
| `company_industry` | Computer Software |
